summary: Nam Tai Property Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited Q2 2026 results, including a net loss of $2.9 million versus a prior-year profit, with revenue down 65%. The release covers financial position, cash, real estate assets, and an equity-for-rent initiative. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, etc.) is disclosed. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation.
